660   // Try all possible grid configurations
661   for (int test_cols = 1; test_cols <= source_count; test_cols++) {
662     int test_rows = (int)ceil((double)source_count / test_cols);
663
664     // Skip configurations with too many empty cells
665     int empty_cells = (test_cols * test_rows) - source_count;
666     if (empty_cells > source_count / 2)
667       continue; // Don't waste more than 50% space
668
669     // Calculate the size each cell would have
670     int cell_width = (width - (test_cols - 1)) / test_cols;   // -1 per separator
671     int cell_height = (height - (test_rows - 1)) / test_rows; // -1 per separator
672
673     // Skip if cells would be too small
674     if (cell_width < 10 || cell_height < 3)
675       continue;
676
677     // Calculate the aspect ratio of each cell (accounting for char aspect)
678     float cell_aspect = ((float)cell_width / (float)cell_height) / char_aspect;
679
680     // Score based on how close to square (1:1) each video cell would be
681     // This naturally adapts to any terminal size
682     float aspect_score = 1.0f - fabsf(logf(cell_aspect)); // log makes it symmetric around 1
683     if (aspect_score < 0)
684       aspect_score = 0;
685
686     // Bonus for better space utilization
687     float utilization = (float)source_count / (float)(test_cols * test_rows);
688
689     // For 2 clients specifically, heavily weight the aspect score
690     // This makes 2 clients naturally go horizontal on wide terminals and vertical on tall ones
691     float total_score;
692     if (source_count == 2) {
693       // For 2 clients, we want the layout that gives the most square-ish cells
694       total_score = aspect_score * 0.9f + utilization * 0.1f;
695     } else {
696       // For 3+ clients, balance aspect ratio with space utilization
697       total_score = aspect_score * 0.7f + utilization * 0.3f;
698     }
699
700     // Small bonus for simpler grids (prefer 2x2 over 3x1, etc.)
701     if (test_cols == test_rows) {
702       total_score += 0.05f; // Slight preference for square grids
703     }
704
705     if (total_score > best_score) {
706       best_score = total_score;
707       best_cols = test_cols;
708       best_rows = test_rows;
709     }
710   }
711
712   *grid_cols = best_cols;
713   *grid_rows = best_rows;
714   return ASCIICHAT_OK;
715 }
